frozen_candidate_root_contribution: The root contributes the undoing or absence of sound, functioning integrity: the passage of some ordered/wholesome state into ruin, spoilage, breakdown, disorder. It is the counter-state to ص ل ح (soundness/being-set-right). Intransitively it is "to fall into ruin/disorder" (a system losing its working coherence); causatively/agentively it is "to bring to ruin, to spoil, to work corruption." The invariant is not an act of destruction per se but the resulting loss of a sound, integral order.

It is the counter-state to ص ل ح (soundness/being-set-right). Intransitively it is "to fall into ruin/disorder" (a system losing its working coherence); causatively/agentively it is "to bring to ruin, to spoil, to work corruption." internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Every one of the 50 occurrences turns on one idea: a sound, working order being spoiled or falling apart — the opposite of things being set right (صلاح). Three verb-forms describe the cosmos itself "going to ruin" if it had multiple gods (21:22, 23:71, 2:251) — pure, agent-free breakdown of ordered functioning. The Form IV verbs and the participle مفسدون/مفسدين describe people who "bring ruin" in the land (spreading disorder, bloodshed, cutting ties, mismanaging orphans' estates). The noun فساد names the ruined state itself ("corruption appeared on land and sea," 30:41). Whether spontaneous (heavens/earth) or caused (people in the earth), the shared residue is: the loss/undoing of a sound, integral order.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: ROOT residue = ruin/spoilage of sound order. FORM carries the diathesis: Form I فَسَدَتْ (V, 3x: 21:22, 23:71, 2:251) = intransitive arising of the ruined state; Form IV (V(IV) 15x, N(IV) 21x) = causative "make/work ruin" and its agent-noun مفسد. The bare noun N (11x: فساد/الفساد/فسادًا) names the state. CONSTRUCTION فِى ٱلْأَرْض / فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْر localizes the ruin to the social/earthly order; the recurrent antonymic frame with ص ل ح (2:11 muslihūn; 7:56 ba'da islāhihā; 26:152/27:48 wa lā yuslihūn; 2:220 al-mufsid min al-muslih; 7:142 aslih wa lā tattabi' sabīl al-mufsidīn) is a construction/context signal, not root. PARTICIPANTS+CONTEXT supply the moral/violent coloring (bloodshed 2:30, destroying crops/offspring 2:205, cutting kinship 47:22, mismanaging orphans 2:220) — these are the objects/scenes, subtracting them leaves only "brought-to-ruin," which is exactly what the Form I cosmic cases show with no moral agent at all.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 2:220 (ٱلْمُفْسِدَ مِنَ ٱلْمُصْلِحِ) is the mildest, non-violent case — merely mismanaging/spoiling an orphan's estate, with no "corruption in the land" crime-scene. It could tempt a narrower "large-scale social evil" gloss, but it in fact confirms the residue: the mufsid is precisely the one who spoils/ruins the affair as against the one who sets it right, matching the antonymy exactly. The disciplining case in the other direction is 21:22 لَفَسَدَتَا (heavens and earth "would go to ruin"): it has no moral agent, so it forbids reading the root as "evildoing" and forces the neutral "breakdown of sound order."
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: Competing gloss: the root = "moral/social evildoing, mischief, wickedness." This fails universal presence: the Form I cosmic occurrences (21:22, 23:71, 2:251) predicate فسد of the heavens, earth, and world-order themselves with no moral agent — nothing there is doing wrong; a functioning system would simply disintegrate. The "breakdown/ruin of sound order" reading covers both these and the agentive earthly cases, so the moral content is shown to be a Form-IV-plus-context contribution, not root residue.
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: The residue is distinctive and falsifiable against nearest roots. vs ه ل ك (perishing/annihilation): 2:205 separates لِيُفْسِدَ فِيهَا from وَيُهْلِكَ ٱلْحَرْثَ وَٱلنَّسْلَ — fsd is the broader spoiling of order, halāk a specific consequent destruction; fsd is a gradient result-state, not punctual annihilation. vs ظ ل م (wrongdoing/injustice): the two co-occur (27:14) but stay distinct — zulm is the moral wrong, fsd its systemic outcome of ruined order. vs ن ق ض/ق ط ع (breaking covenant/severing, 13:25, 2:27, 47:22): those name specific severing acts that lead to fsd. The tightest falsifiable anchor is the internal ص ل ح antonymy: fsd is defined in-corpus as the exact contrary of soundness/being-set-right — a test any candidate occurrence must pass.
internal_discovery.rationale: All 50 confirmed occurrences reconcile to a single, non-empty residue — the ruin/spoilage/breakdown of sound, functioning integrity (the counter-state to صلاح) — after subtracting form and context. The four form classes cleanly instantiate one meaning under different diatheses: Form I = the ruined state arising intransitively (cosmic cases), Form IV verb/participle = causing it and its agent, bare noun = the state named. No occurrence resists: even the mildest (2:220, orphan's estate) and the crime-scene cases (5:32-33-64) fit, and the agent-free cosmic cases (21:22, 23:71, 2:251) positively require the neutral "breakdown of order" reading over any moral gloss, defeating the strongest competing hypothesis. Distinctiveness is secured by the corpus's own systematic ص ل ح antonymy and by explicit contrast with ه ل ك (2:205). Because universal presence holds across the full set with a distinctive, falsifiable residue grounded in cited verses, the judgment is PREFERRED at STRONG strength.

adversarial_verification.notes: Full coverage: all 50 confirmed occurrences accounted for across four form buckets — Form I intransitive (3), Form IV verb (15), Form IV participle mufsid- (21), noun fasad- (11). The proposed invariant ("undoing/absence of sound functioning integrity; passage of an ordered/wholesome state into ruin, spoilage, breakdown; counter-state to ص ل ح") is demonstrably present in EVERY occurrence after subtracting form/construction/context. Intransitive residue (fall into ruin) is witnessed in 21:22, 23:71, 2:251 (heavens/earth/land losing working coherence). Agentive/causative residue (work corruption, spoil) covers all Form IV verbs and participles; 27:34 afsaduhA (ruining a town) is concrete spoilage of an ordered whole. Nouns (30:41 fasAd appearing on land and sea; 8:73 fasAd kabIr; 89:12) name the resulting disordered state. Adversarial refutation attempt found NO resistant/anomalous occurrence and no homonym: the root is among the most unified in the corpus. Distinctiveness OK — the text itself repeatedly opposes fsd to صلح (2:11 mufsidun vs muslihun; 2:220 al-mufsid min al-muslih; 7:56/7:85 ba'da islAHihA; 26:152/27:48 wa lA yuSliHun), confirming the 'counter-state to soundness' residue rather than generic evil; and distinct from هلك (2:205 pairs liyufsida with wa yuhlika — corrupt an order vs annihilate a thing). Falsifiable: prediction that every token lies in the ruin/loss-of-sound-order field is testable and unbroken across all 50. Universal presence holds; verdict SUPPORTED.
